findings.description: The inline policy grants wildcard actions (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) on all resources ("Resource": "*") to an IAM user, violating least privilege and allowing broad account-wide access if the user's credentials are compromised.

A long-lived access key/secret is created for an IAM user with excessive permissions, increasing the blast radius if the key is leaked; static credentials are inherently riskier than temporary role-based credentials.

findings.issue_category: use of IAM user instead of role
findings.description: An IAM user with force_destroy and an attached over-permissive policy is created rather than using roles with temporary credentials, increasing risk of credential leakage and standing privileged access.
